newsitem.title: USA: Rigid disk drive growth slowed in '96 - Dataquest.
newsitem.headline: Rigid disk drive growth slowed in '96 - Dataquest.

text.p: The worldwide rigid disk drive market showed slower growth in 1996 as unit shipments rose 18 percent over 1995, well below 1995's growth rate of 30 percent, said Dataquest.
Shipments reached 106 million units in 1996, up from 90 million units shipped in 1995, said the global market research and consulting company.
"1996 was a pretty good year, in spite of a slow start, and we believe that 1997 will be even better," said Phil Devin, vice president and chief analyst of Dataquest's Computer Storage program.
